subject.title: feat(codex): instrument dynamic-tool bridge phase timing

question: Should OpenClaw retain an info-level timing event for every Codex dynamic-tool response, or should this instrumentation be bounded or diagnostic-only?
rationale: The code makes a durable operational-policy choice about always-on per-call logging that tests cannot settle, and the prior review explicitly left that choice to a maintainer.

options.title: Use bounded diagnostics
options.body: Record the timing only through an approved diagnostic, sampling, or bounded observability path so normal Codex tool traffic does not create an unbounded info-log stream.

options.title: Accept always-on logging
options.body: Keep the current info event if maintainers explicitly accept the operational volume and retention implications for every Codex dynamic-tool call.

options.title: Pause instrumentation
options.body: Defer this slice if no supported logging policy can retain the measurements without undesirable steady-state operational cost.

recommendation.title: Use bounded diagnostics
recommendation.body: Record the timing only through an approved diagnostic, sampling, or bounded observability path so normal Codex tool traffic does not create an unbounded info-log stream.

likelyOwner.reason: The client response boundary is the concrete logging-policy decision point, and prior history connects cyrusaf to that app-server client path.
